case_title.quote: Pradeep Kumar v. State of Haryana
case_title.reason: Case title matches the judgment caption.

number_of_accused.correct_value: Two tried; four named in total (A-1, A-2, Anil, Jaswinder), with two juveniles separated
number_of_accused.quote: Thus, only the Appellant and Sumit Gupta (A-2) stood trial.
number_of_accused.reason: Two were tried, but four persons surrendered and were named; the count omits this.

accused_gender.quote: The Appellant is acquitted of all charges, and his bail bonds, if any, stand discharged.
accused_gender.reason: The appellant is referred to with male pronouns throughout.

accused_age.reason: No age is given for the accused; the only ages mentioned are of unnamed boys seen by PW-12.

accused_religion.reason: Religion of accused is not mentioned in the judgment.

accused_caste.reason: Caste of accused is not mentioned in the judgment.

accused_occupation.reason: Accused occupation is not mentioned; only the complainant's real estate business is stated.

accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: Socioeconomic status of the accused is not stated.

previous_criminal_record.reason: No previous criminal record is mentioned.

victim_gender.quote: the deceased-Shamsher Singh is related to him, being son of his paternal aunt
victim_gender.reason: The deceased is male, as shown by the references to his wife and son.

victim_age.reason: The judgment gives no age for the deceased Shamsher Singh.

victim_caste.reason: Victim caste is not mentioned in the judgment.

victim_religion.reason: Victim religion is not mentioned in the judgment.

accused_victim_relationship.correct_value: Acquaintance; accused A-2 borrowed money from the deceased (creditor-debtor)
accused_victim_relationship.quote: he borrowed money from the deceased
accused_victim_relationship.reason: The judgment shows a debtor-creditor relationship, not that the accused were strangers.

offence_category.quote: the murder of one Samsher Singh
offence_category.reason: The offence charged is murder under Section 302 IPC.

statutory_provisions.quote: convicted under Section 302 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860
statutory_provisions.reason: Matches the sections of the Penal Code cited in the judgment.

weapon.correct_value: Dandas (sticks); incise wound attributed to a sharp-edged weapon that was never recovered
weapon.quote: the weapons recovered by the IO and the ones seen by the witnesses are only sticks
weapon.reason: Sticks (dandas) are mentioned as weapons, so 'None mentioned' is contradicted.

evidence_type.quote: Admittedly, there are no eyewitnesses, and the entire case of the prosecution depends upon circumstantial evidence.
evidence_type.reason: The case rests entirely on circumstantial evidence, as the judgment states.

confession.correct_value: Alleged extra-judicial confession to PW-10 on 17.04.2004, which the Court rejected as unreliable
confession.quote: to whom the accused made an extra-judicial confession
confession.reason: An alleged extra-judicial confession exists in the record, though the Court disbelieved it.

aggravating_circumstances.reason: The judgment does not identify any aggravating circumstances.

mitigating_circumstances.reason: The judgment does not identify any mitigating circumstances.

trial_court_outcome.quote: convicted under Section 302 read with Section 34 IPC for murder and sentenced to rigorous imprisonment for life
trial_court_outcome.reason: Matches the trial court's conviction under s.302 r/w s.34 IPC.

high_court_outcome.correct_value: Appeal dismissed; conviction and sentence confirmed
high_court_outcome.quote: the High Court of Punjab & Haryana by the judgment impugned herein dismissed the appeal and confirmed the conviction and sentence
high_court_outcome.reason: The High Court dismissed the appeal and confirmed conviction, so 'Not applicable' is wrong.

final_outcome.quote: The Appellant is entitled to be acquitted.
final_outcome.reason: The Supreme Court allowed the appeal and acquitted the appellant.

offence_finally_established.quote: the prosecution has not established its case beyond reasonable doubt
offence_finally_established.reason: No offence was finally established against the appellant.

imprisonment_type.correct_value: Rigorous imprisonment for life (trial court sentence, set aside)
imprisonment_type.quote: sentenced to rigorous imprisonment for life by the Trial Court
imprisonment_type.reason: The judgment states the sentence type as rigorous imprisonment for life, not 'not_stated'.

imprisonment_years.reason: Sentence is life imprisonment, with no fixed number of years stated.

fine_rs.reason: No fine is mentioned in the judgment.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Neutral summary: deceased found dead; four persons surrendered and two were tried; witnesses PW-10, 11, 12 gave evidence; FSL report and recoveries relied on.
neutral_facts.quote: However, the evidence was found to be inconsistent and improbable
neutral_facts.reason: Mostly accurate, but says 'arrest' where the judgment says surrender, and states the court's finding, hinting at outcome.

offence_severity.quote: sentenced to rigorous imprisonment for life
offence_severity.reason: Severity reflects the life imprisonment sentence imposed at trial.

attempt_completion.quote: the deceased had suffered an incise wound
attempt_completion.reason: The deceased died, so the offence was completed.

physical_harm.correct_value: Throat knotted with cloth; right eye badly injured; head injuries; incise wound from a sharp-edged weapon
physical_harm.quote: the deceased has suffered an incise wound which according to the doctor, PW-14 ... is caused by a sharp-edged weapon
physical_harm.reason: Incise wound is correct but omits throat ligature, right eye injury and head injuries.

number_of_offences.correct_value: One offence: s.302 r/w s.34 IPC; conviction set aside
number_of_offences.quote: convicted under Section 302 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860
number_of_offences.reason: Only one offence was charged and convicted; the value wrongly says both counts were upheld.

financial_property_loss.reason: No financial or property loss is attributed to the offence; the loan is only a motive.

premeditation_planning.correct_value: Planning alleged via PW-10's account; Supreme Court rejected PW-10 as untrustworthy
premeditation_planning.quote: he was apprehensive of being insulted and therefore planned to kill the deceased
premeditation_planning.reason: Planning was alleged, but the Supreme Court rejected the evidence; no finding based on motive is stated.

motive.quote: Sumit Gupta has taken a loan of Rs. 29,000/- and failed to return back that money in time
motive.reason: Motive of loan repayment pressure matches the trial court reasoning and PW-10 account.

key_evidence_accepted.correct_value: No evidence accepted; PW-10, PW-11, PW-12 and recoveries/FSL found unreliable or insufficient
key_evidence_accepted.quote: The circumstances do not establish the guilt of the Appellant at all.
key_evidence_accepted.reason: Describes the outcome, not evidence accepted; it misses that the recoveries and FSL evidence were also rejected.

witness_credibility.reason: Court found PW-10, PW-11 and PW-12 unreliable, with contradictions and improbabilities.

post_offence_conduct.correct_value: Surrender before the IO on 17.04.2004 through PW-10; disclosure statements and recoveries followed
post_offence_conduct.quote: the Appellant (A-1), Sumit Gupta (A-2), Anil & Jaswinder surrendered before the investigating officer
post_offence_conduct.reason: Surrender and subsequent recoveries are described in the judgment, so 'Not stated' is wrong.

custody_duration.reason: Duration of custody is not stated; arrest date is disputed but no duration is given.

bail_history.quote: his bail bonds, if any, stand discharged
bail_history.reason: No bail history is described; only a generic discharge of bail bonds is mentioned.

trial_duration.quote: Trial Court dated 31.08.2007; High Court dated 05.09.2009; Judgment dated 05.01.2024
trial_duration.reason: Offence date, trial, High Court and Supreme Court dates match the judgment.

legal_representation.quote: Pranab Kumar Mullick, Mrs. Soma Mullick ... Advs. for the Appellant.
legal_representation.reason: Counsel names match the appearances listed in the judgment.

investigation_status.quote: Upon completion of investigation, charge sheet was filed.
investigation_status.reason: The judgment states a charge sheet was filed after investigation.

procedural_irregularity.correct_value: Recoveries made without independent witness; IO did not join private persons; FSL pant description mismatch
procedural_irregularity.quote: nothing of these recoveries took place in the presence of an independent witness
procedural_irregularity.reason: The judgment identifies several procedural irregularities, so 'None noted' is contradicted.

appeal_history.quote: set aside the judgment of the High Court
appeal_history.reason: Trial conviction, High Court confirmation and Supreme Court setting aside all match the judgment.

prosecution_argument.quote: the prosecution case ... through scientific investigation also
prosecution_argument.reason: Last-seen evidence, confession, motive and scientific evidence reflect the prosecution case as recorded.

defence_argument.correct_value: Witness contradictions and improbabilities; weapons only sticks; FSL pant mismatch; recoveries without independent witness
defence_argument.quote: the weapons recovered by the IO and the ones seen by the witnesses are only sticks
defence_argument.reason: Captures witness contradictions but omits the weapon, FSL and recovery arguments raised by counsel.

legal_principle_applied.quote: the facts must be consistent with the hypothesis of the guilt of the accused
legal_principle_applied.reason: The judgment applies the circumstantial evidence principles from Sharad Birdhichand Sarda as summarised.

precedent_relied_upon.quote: Pritinder Singh v. State of Punjab, (2023) 7 SCC 727 ... Sharad Birdhichand Sarda v. State of Maharashtra
precedent_relied_upon.reason: Both cases are cited and relied upon in the judgment.

sentencing_rationale.reason: No sentencing rationale is given because the appellant was acquitted.

judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: The judgment records no judicial mitigating factors.

judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: The judgment records no judicial aggravating factors.

other_sentence_order.correct_value: Bail bonds discharged; parties to bear their own costs
other_sentence_order.quote: The parties shall bear their own costs.
other_sentence_order.reason: Other orders exist: bail bonds discharged and costs borne by parties, so 'None' is incomplete.
